zones: any represented zone from which the selected card is authorized to be cast
objects: one source-pinned fixed ordinary or colored-hybrid Evoke card
costs: one fixed ordinary or colored-hybrid alternative mana cost
an exact reviewed nonmana override may supply the same typed payment marker
timing: the alternative cost is chosen while proposing the cast
the sacrifice trigger is collected on the permanent's actual entry and resolves through the ordinary stack
choices: select one payable Evoke alternative branch
order simultaneous same-controller entry triggers bottom-to-top
hidden_information: the hand card remains owner-private until cast
the cast marker is authoritative internal state and never projected
apnap: the sacrifice occurrence enters the same immutable APNAP trigger batch as other represented entry triggers
layers: granted or removed Evoke is excluded until one shared ability-applicability query exists
replacement_effects: spell-resolution and sacrifice movement delegate to canonical zone-transition replacement owners
copy: spell copies are not cast and do not receive an Evoke payment marker
control_change: the permanent's controller when the trigger is created controls and performs the sacrifice
zone_change: the typed marker reaches only the resolving cast incarnation and is cleared if it does not enter the battlefield
sacrifice resolves only if the same logical permanent remains present
source_leaves: the triggered occurrence retains source identity after creation and sacrifices only the still-present source

variants: fixed generic, colored, colorless, and colored-hybrid mana costs

implementation.supported_slice: Printed fixed ordinary or colored-hybrid Evoke on a trusted selected cast face, plus exact reviewed typed nonmana overrides, using one shared entry-trigger owner.

known_blockers: arbitrary nonmana, variable, Phyrexian, snow, and wider hybrid Evoke costs
granted, copied, removed, or text-changed Evoke until one shared ability-applicability query exists
complete alternative-cost, replacement, and trigger interaction coverage
